notes: BLOCKED: this manifest records the accepted launch-token artifact and unresolved application deployment findings. The empty contracts list does not represent completion or approval of the requested feed/oracle/vault increment. LaunchToken() is the accepted argument-free COMP Launch / CPL / 18-decimal artifact. The required evm_project token-and-pool format conflicts with the approved workflow's explicit no-new-token requirement; that conflict needs resolution before admission. The pool describes CPL paired with native ETH, no hook, with initialPrice expressed as decimal sqrtPriceX96. The factory supplies the LP and MerkleDistributor. Application findings: (1) The workflow requires separate price and NHI instances of SwarmFeed, but the accepted source exposes only the single SwarmFeed identifier. Unique manifest identifiers and the absence of an instance-alias field prevent listing it twice. Separately named accepted feed artifacts or a supported deployment representation are needed; a single shared feed would incorrectly couple the two channels. (2) Approved immutable question hashes, maxAge and maxDeviationBps values for both feeds are missing. The attestation TTL of 3600 seconds does not itself specify feed freshness. Test fixture hashes and bounds are not deployment inputs. Reporter authority must resolve from policy via $owner, with quorum 1 and unused reporter slots zero; compatibility with the workflow's designated reporter remains a policy check. (3) The current CDPVault constructor takes five addresses in order: imdToken, compToken, oracle, priceFeed, nhiFeed. The workflow specifies existing collateral 0x5e223eb2ea5d55b4a8d4190e94df3524b58dfc79 and existing stablecoin 0x70bc53314feac5251274ef65e49fd11c0d679bfe. Neither is redeployed. A zero oracle argument creates and permanently binds a fresh MockWorkOracle inside the vault constructor; it needs no separate manifest entry. The workflow requires distinct, previously deployed feeds for the last two arguments. Zero compToken is rejected, so the previous three-argument self-contained deployment is invalid. (4) MockWorkOracle obtains grantRights authority from the hard-coded operator in DeploymentConfig.sol, not policy via $owner, and exposes no owner constructor argument. This is an unresolved source/authorization conflict. (5) The existing COMP token requires separate requester authorization of the new vault; a manifest cannot make that call. Its live ability to authorize this vault has not been verified. No initialization calls are specified. The accepted CDPVault ABI export and deployment documentation still describe the earlier constructor and require source-owner correction. These findings cannot be repaired by editing this manifest alone. Notes are explanatory, not deployment authority. Services own policy, signed artifact linkage, publication, attestation, admission, deployment and frontend startup; no later service outcome is claimed here.
